status: Illustrative planning assumptions, not actual BOM or legal determination
denominator: Cost of direct components, excluding manufacture of the end product

products.title: Quadruped: localize the highest-value assemblies.
products.name: Quadruped
products.note: Joint assemblies are the largest dependency. Imported finished joints cannot become domestic merely through a U.S. reseller.
products.zh: 机器狗示例把关节/腿部组件设为 42% 成本。80% 方案依赖该部分和其他组件确实符合美国制造认定。全部关节如果不能计入国内，比例会从 80% 降到 38%。

products.title: Dexterous hand: cost lives in the micro joints.
products.name: Dexterous hand
products.note: A shared micro-drive design concentrates cost engineering, calibration and replacement parts in one module family.
products.zh: 灵巧手拆解为微型关节、手指与掌部结构、传感、控制板和腕部线束。占比是设计预算，不能引用为现有产品真实 BOM。微关节占 48%，是成本优化和原产地认定重点。

products.title: Dual arms: reuse joints, links and test fixtures.
products.name: Dual-arm platform
products.note: A fixed industrial arm configuration has a different FCC scope analysis from a mobile robot carrying the same arm.
products.zh: 双臂可复用关节、连杆与工装。固定式工业机器人在当前相关 FCC 定义中有排除条款，但无线、电磁兼容和安全等其他要求仍应单独判断。装到移动底盘后的系统要重新分析。

products.title: Spherical robot: separate mobility from payload.
products.name: Spherical robot
products.note: A common drive core can support multiple sensing payloads. Origin and authorization follow the shipped configuration.
products.zh: 球形机器人以外壳、摆锤驱动、飞轮稳定、电池、传感计算和功率线束分组。AI 爆炸图只解释结构，不是正式 CAD 或实际装配图。IP68 等未经检测的指标不写成已认证事实。
